## Current caption

> The celestial pole altitude equals the observer's latitude. An observer at latitude $ $ sees the pole at altitude $h = $ above the horizon. At the equator the pole is at the horizon ($h = 0^ $); at either terrestrial pole it is directly overhead ($h = 90^ $).
